raw_segments.text: Fourthly, the delivery also of the people into the subjection of a foreign power, either
by the prince or by the legislative, is certainly a change of the legislative, and so a dissolution
of the government, for the end why people entered into society being to be preserved
one entire, free, independent society, to be governed by its own laws.
This is lost, whenever they are given up into the power of another.
